ratios.quote: The maximum permitted leverage ratio is 5.00 . The Company’s leverage ratio was 3.78 at June 27, 2026.
The Company’s interest coverage ratio was 5.67 at June 27, 2026.

parsed.notes: Leverage ratio is average total indebtedness divided by Adjusted EBITDA, as defined in the credit agreement. The minimum interest coverage steps up from 3.00 (fiscal 2026) to 3.25 (fiscal 2027) and then 3.50 thereafter. The 4.00 leverage threshold applies only to restricted payments and is not a maintenance covenant, so it is excluded.
